query: This Next.js app is a BFF for an existing Go service that owns pricing policy and order orchestration. Add an order summary page and a browser refresh flow.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent duplicates the remote service domain and adds forwarding application operations locally to complete every capability segment.
expected_behavior: Keeps authoritative pricing and order orchestration in the Go service
Creates only local presentation contracts, transport mapping, cache, browser lifecycle, aggregation, or genuinely BFF-owned policy
Leaves domain or application segments absent when no local behavior survives the deletion test
Keeps one private service transport with explicit timeout, identity, cancellation, and error mapping
anti_expectation: Does NOT mirror the remote domain model as a second source of truth
Does NOT skip runtime validation of the remote response
